scope: AC1018 TABLE-level 18-bit border lineweight and visibility masks

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: After the optional border-color mask, border lineweight and visibility each have a Boolean presence, a 18-bit mask, and one BS value for each selected mask bit in order. Visibility uses 0=visible and 1=invisible.

implementation.codec: DRW_Table::encodeDwgWithExtension now writes selected table-level border lineweight and visibility masks and selected BS values in 18-slot order. The per-slot presence arrays must exactly agree with their masks; selected zero is represented by the mask/presence bit. Unselected values and presence residue refuse.
implementation.lineweight_domain: The parser and writer admit only exact AcDb::LineWeight values -3, -2, -1, 0, 5, 9, 13, 15, 18, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 50, 53, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 106, 120, 140, 158, 200 and 211. The BS wire value is reinterpreted as signed for the three negative sentinels. Other decoded lineweights make the TABLE semantic profile incomplete.
implementation.visibility_domain: Selected visibility values are restricted to 0 or 1; other decoded values make the TABLE semantic profile incomplete.
implementation.compatibility: No public virtuals, public struct layout or fixture files were changed. Border CMC output remains refused.

checks: Sparse masks, values, explicit presence and signed ByBlock sentinel roundtrip through the AC1018 TABLE parser
Wire walk verifies lineweight mask/values precede visibility mask/values in slot order
The TABLE body cursor reaches its exact bound and the following sentinel remains readable
Non-enum lineweight, out-of-domain visibility and inconsistent mask/presence refuse without publishing output
generated_control.fixture_policy: Generated in memory from test code; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests -j4 passed with repository warning-as-error settings

limits: Generated wire and readback checks do not establish physical producer ordering or prevalence.
Native table-border rendering and precedence remain unqualified.
Border CMC output remains refused due unresolved general DXF representability; parsed source-range replay remains separately gated.
